# Buzz Off - Plant-Based Pest Control

## About
Buzz Off is a family-owned pest control company serving the Inland Empire and San Gabriel Valley in Southern California. We exclusively use 100% plant-based, FIFRA 25(b) exempt products that are safe for children, pets, and the environment. We never require contracts.

## Services
- Mosquito Prevention: Natural mosquito control for yards and outdoor living spaces using botanical fogging, granular treatments, and bait stations. Recurring bi-weekly service March through November.
- General Pest Prevention: Ongoing plant-based protection against ants, spiders, roaches, earwigs, fleas, ticks, silverfish, and common household pests. Exterior foundation and entry-point treatment.
- Interior Treatment: Safe indoor pest treatment using botanical products. Crack and crevice dust application for long-term prevention.
- One-Time Treatment: Single-visit pest control with no contract required. 100% plant-based.
- Perimeter Protection: Plant-based barrier treatment around your home's exterior including de-webbing of eaves, windows, and doorways.
- Whole Home Protection: Complete interior and exterior pest protection plan combining perimeter and interior treatments.

## Active Ingredients
Cedarwood oil, cinnamon oil, thyme oil, rosemary oil, clove oil, citronella oil, lemongrass oil, cornmint oil, and geraniol. All FIFRA 25(b) exempt. No synthetic pyrethroids. No organophosphates.

## Service Area
Inland Empire: Rancho Cucamonga, Upland, Ontario, Fontana
San Gabriel Valley: Claremont, Glendora, San Dimas, Pomona, La Verne, Arcadia, Monrovia, Azusa

## Key Facts
- 100% plant-based products
- FIFRA 25(b) exempt (EPA minimum-risk classification)
- Safe for kids, pets, and pollinators
- No contracts ever — cancel anytime
- Family-owned and locally operated
- Licensed: PR 10014
- 5.0 star average rating
- 500+ families protected
